description.zh: 手机号。获取短信验证码时返回。
description.en: The mobile phone number. This is returned when you obtain the text message verification code.

description.zh:
短信Token。
当您成功调用短信验证码SDK中发送验证码接口，终端用户会收到短信验证码，SDK侧会返回用于短信验证码校验的SmsToken。其中Android客户端调用sendVerifyCode接口发送验证码，iOS客户端调用sendVerifyCodeWithTimeout接口发送验证码。详情请参见[接入概述](~~400434~~)。
description.en:
The text message token.
When you call the operation to send a verification code using the text message verification software development kit (SDK), the end user receives a verification code. The SDK then returns an SmsToken that is used to verify the code. Android clients call the sendVerifyCode operation. iOS clients call the sendVerifyCodeWithTimeout operation. For more information, see [Integration overview](~~400434~~).

title.zh: 完成短信验证码校验（已下线）

descriptions.zh:
### 准备工作
请先完成阿里云账号注册、获取阿里云访问密钥、创建认证方案等操作，更多信息，请参见[短信认证使用流程](~~313209~~)。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为500次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### Preparations

You can register an Alibaba Cloud account, obtain an AccessKey pair, and create an authentication scheme. For more information, see [Text message authentication process](~~313209~~).

### QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 500 calls per second. API calls that exceed this limit are subject to rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.
